entities.name: Goro-Goro
entities.description: A goblin samurai (once a young akki) of Kamigawa devoted to the dragon Ryusei, who follows Atsushi making offerings.

entities.name: Ryusei
entities.description: Former incarnation of Atsushi, a great dragon.

entities.name: Atsushi
entities.description: Dragon, reincarnation of Ryusei, who tolerates Goro-Goro's offerings.

entities.name: Satoru Umezawa
entities.description: Defender of Kamigawa who fought beside Goro-Goro.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Goro-Goro fought to defend Kamigawa.

events.summary: Goro-Goro hears tales of Ryusei as a young akki and dedicates his life to the dragon.
events.quote: he decided to dedicate his life to Ryusei

events.summary: Goro-Goro follows Atsushi and makes offerings in Ryusei's name; Atsushi spares him for the valuable offerings.
events.quote: the offerings Goro-Goro makes are just valuable enough that the dragon permits him to live

events.summary: Goro-Goro fights beside Satoru Umezawa in defense of Kamigawa during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Goro-Goro fought alongside Satoru Umezawa in defense of Kamigawa

relations.quote: Ryusei , the former incarnation of Atsushi
Goro-Goro fought alongside Satoru Umezawa in defense of Kamigawa
